★Request
Ryan looking toward the scenery on the left side of the screen

--In the first place, I'm just toootally not
"highborn lady" material, you know? Ahahaha.
The day after the selection race, as I was heading home after finishing work--

However, the lack of confidence in her "reason to run,"
which had built up since childhood, seemed to be holding her back from her true potential.

It appears Mejiro McQueen is aiming for victory
in her specialty, the 3200m turf, at the Sports Festival.
Against McQueen, of course.

I can't imagine running with our family's name on my shoulders, nor do I have that kind of resolve.
No, even if I did... I could never reach the noble heights she does.

Is that so... I'm sorry for causing trouble.
I'll have to apologize to Ines later too.
Yeah... well, yes.

Ryan-chan trains so much every single day, so normally
if you check the track or the gym, she's always there, but...

To tell the truth, ever since class ended,
Ryan-chan hasn't been anywhere to be found...

Although she tried to put on a cheerful smile,
it felt like the issues she carried ran quite deep...

But taking a break and looking at the view from up here...
kind of brought back a lot of memories.

Still, I know full well.
I could never do what McQueen does.
Ah, Trainer!
There is no such event in the Sports Festival!

Huh? Wait... Trainer.
What are you doing here?

Was there anything I could do for her?
Pondering that question, I returned to the academy--

...Near the Mejiro estate, there was a hill just like this.
Once you climbed to the top of that long, steep slope, you could see such a beautiful view.

Many guests will be attending the Sports Festival,
so I must present a performance befitting the prestigious Mejiro name!

Let's see... out of everyone in the Mejiro household, she and I were especially
close. Like childhood friends... or maybe sisters, I guess?
McQueen is... she's been truly amazing ever since we were little.

Really?!
Thanks, Trainer!! That's a huge help...!

Still though, Mac-chan's doing long-distance again, huh?
Wouldn't it be cool to see you do a 1200m blitz once in a while?
...for my sights are firmly set upon the Tenno Sho.

--Ah!!
You're the Trainer who was at the selection race yesterday, right?!
...Understood. I'll give it some thought.

Still... I'm entering anyway.
If you'd like, please come watch.

Um... I finished signing up yesterday.
I'll be competing in the 3200m turf at the Sports Festival, just like McQueen.

I explained that Ines Fujin was worried about her,
and that I had come looking for her out of concern as well.

I just felt like running outside today.
I meant to get back before anyone started worrying, but...

I just like moving my body.
Really... that's all there is to it.
--She's completely different from me.
Why are you telling me that now, though...?

Searching through the academy, nearby riverbanks, parks, shopping streets, and the station plaza.
After scouring countless places, I finally--

Today, no matter where I checked, I couldn't find her at all.
She seemed off during yesterday's race too, so I'm really worried...

She learned poise, refined her appearance properly,
and lives up to the expectations of everyone supporting the Mejiro family...

Though honestly... I don't really know
why I ended up doing that myself.

And so, Mejiro Ryan threw herself into even more intense
training than usual...
Well... no, it's not like I don't want to, but...

Ahaha.
You're really kind, Trainer.

Come to think of it... how long has it been
since I last had a proper race against McQueen...?

Though back then, I was like this and McQueen was already so composed, so
I couldn't really act like much of a big sister at all.

Come to think of it, the "Event-by-Event Sports Festival," where Tracen Academy's
horse girls compete in events of their choosing, is set to be held soon.
Something I might realize...

Maybe wanting to train harder than usual is just me
being unable to sit still, though...

...The root of the issue Mejiro Ryan is facing is
undoubtedly Mejiro McQueen. In that case--
Huh...? Me, entering the same race as McQueen?

Splitting up with Ines Fujin,
I searched everywhere for Mejiro Ryan.
And a few days later, when I went to check on Mejiro Ryan--

Phew... that's a wrap, huh?
...Mm, no, just one more set--

So back in the day, we used to race up there all the time.
To see who could reach that view first... all of us Mejiro kids.

Polished through ceaseless training day and night,
Mejiro Ryan's physical potential was originally quite exceptional.
I... really respect McQueen.

Oho, McQueen's running the 3200m turf, huh?
What should I do? Maybe the 5000m freestyle after all?

Always thinking about how a horse girl carrying the Mejiro name should act,
what kind of results she needs to deliver, and working hard towards that.
She's been amazingly fast for as long as I can remember...
